_doc: Tool calls are judged against the content version, page turns included; a repeated request id does not run twice (audit F-6).

reader.page_turns.why: two in turn 1, one by hand, one in turn 3; none for the stale call, none for the retry

hub.tool_results.done.why: turn 1 twice, turn 3 twice (the retry gets the first receipt)

hub.tool_results.stale.why: the call prepared before the hand turn is refused

cap.replayed.why: the retry was answered from the first receipt
